text: The Solicitor, Legal Services will provide a training and education session on Sign By-law Provisions, including the area specific restrictions under the By-law; and on aspects of the Sign Variance Committee Procedures.

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to the education or training of the Members. 2. Requested the Manager, City Wide Priorities, Toronto Building to provide a training and education session, to the June 7, 2024 meeting of the Sign Variance Committee, on the requirement and an explanation of the illumination considerations of signs under the By-law.
